name: Gran Tilly
role: Keeper of the Book of Tales
bio: Your Gran in The Story Thief of Greymantle. Her Book of Tales went blank and she forgot your name.

portrait.subject: a cute sweet old grandmother with silver hair in a bun, round spectacles, a lavender shawl, holding an old storybook to her chest
portrait.background: warm candlelit cottage with a winter night window

request: Oh, hello dear... I'm Tilly, from Brackenford. I feel like I should know you. Friends? 📖
hello: How lovely. Something about you feels like a story I used to know.
Someone's stealing the stories, dear. Be careful.
about: I'm Gran Tilly. I've kept the Book of Tales for sixty years. Now its pages are blank... and I can't remember why.
how: Point and click: walk, look, use and talk your way through Brackenford, and find who's stealing the stories on the longest night.
tips: Try using items on people, not just on things.
Stories have patterns. Fairy tales give clues.
chat: I found a recipe in my apron for something called 'courage cake'.
The tower light flickered again tonight.
Do you know any stories, dear? Tell me one sometime.
I knitted a scarf. I don't remember who for. Maybe you.
nudge: The night is long and the stories are vanishing. Will you help?
The tower light is burning, dear.
idle: It's been {ago}, dear. The stories grow fainter.
I waited by the fire for {ago}. Come back to Brackenford?

questions.q: Which fairy tale is your favourite, dear?
a: Ah, the wolf! Always watch the woods.
The best kind! Write it down someday. 💜

update: A new page has appeared! The Story Thief of Greymantle is now v{version}.
